purpose: Advance all seven Album One commissions in parallel to full-form owner frontiers or exact irreducible blockers.

tracks.blocker_policy: Only the exact supplied reference or retained candidate bytes may block the frontier. Missing analysis is not a blocker.
tracks.control: supplied reference plus one serious non-reference-faithful control
machine_steps: Verify the retained proof and release-candidate identities before rebuilding anything.
Reproduce the strongest retained candidate from its committed execution object.
Measure form coverage, recurrence, phrase ownership, transitions, and reference legibility across the complete retained form.
Prepare at most three semantically disclosed cuts: retained incumbent, one bounded repair if machine evidence justifies it, and one serious negative control.
tracks.owner_delta: reference fidelity and full-form legibility; no hidden tool or model swap
tracks.working_title: Pretty Lights — Empire State of Mind

tracks.blocker_policy: Exact reference audio may block convergence, but it may not block whole-form score realization.
tracks.control: neutral score realization versus cross-modal performance realization
machine_steps: Compile the complete bound score, MIDI, MixScore, PlayerPiano, and rack evidence into one whole-form PerformanceScore.
Render the complete source-free score realization before the exact recording is bound.
When exact reference audio is bound, run whole-form score-to-audio alignment and compare performance timing, dynamics, articulation, and form.
Prepare no phrase demos; the owner frontier must contain complete dramatic form.
tracks.owner_delta: neutral notation playback versus accountable performance realization of the same complete work

tracks.blocker_policy: Exact performance audio may block convergence, but it may not block complete community-symbolic realization.
tracks.control: literal symbolic playback versus performance-arrangement realization
machine_steps: Compile the complete community-symbolic witness into piano, acoustic bass, drums, transport, and ensemble obligations.
Render the complete ensemble realization and the proof-carrying adjacent move.
Bind the exact Bad Plus performance and run blind-audio/symbolic convergence across the complete form.
Reject any result that recovers only the Aphex Twin composition while missing The Bad Plus arrangement and ensemble behavior.
tracks.owner_delta: literal notes versus recovered Bad Plus performance grammar over the complete form
tracks.working_title: Aphex Twin / The Bad Plus — Flim

tracks.blocker_policy: Only the two exact private editions or a rights/custody refusal may block execution.
tracks.control: serious naive overlap and identity-preserving Toxic control
machine_steps: Run material census, stem-role evidence, pulse, percussion-event, harmony, and section correspondence before composition.
Build a 60–90 second arrangement whose setup preserves Toxic negative space, whose body imports Animal-derived physical force, and whose payoff remains unmistakably Toxic.
Include the reverse transplant only when it is a causally useful control.
Prepare at most four semantically named cuts; short stem experiments remain machine-side.
tracks.owner_delta: which production and percussion roles move from Animal into Toxic, and which Toxic identity elements remain fixed

tracks.blocker_policy: Only the two exact private editions or a rights/custody refusal may block execution.
machine_steps: Map chorus width, drum lift, guitar resonance, vocal authority, harmonic function, and section ancestry.
Build a 60–90 second arrangement with setup, body, and payoff rather than isolated chorus surgery.
Compare neutral alignment, ancestry transfer, and reverse modernization only when each is a complete musical proposition.
Preserve distinct song identities and reject generic Coldplay imitation.
tracks.owner_delta: how Yellow-like scale, live-band lift, and inevitability enter the sombr song while its identity stays intact
tracks.working_title: sombr My Body Isn’t Ready × Coldplay Yellow

tracks.blocker_policy: The exact source and two curated corpora may block the frontier only after the gesture and arrangement contracts are fully materialized.
tracks.control: non-bhangra contour/rhythm control matched for superficial ascent
machine_steps: Isolate the exact ascending Stateside gesture and represent contour, rhythm, articulation, ornamentation, timbre, and context.
Run held-out retrieval against curated bhangra/Punjabi positives and matched non-bhangra negatives.
Identify the smallest causal mechanism that survives the controls.
Compose a 45–75 second arrangement demonstrating that mechanism in context; do not stop at retrieval.
tracks.owner_delta: the exact contour/rhythm/articulation mechanism that creates the bhangra-adjacent reading, versus a matched non-bhangra control

tracks.blocker_policy: Only exact private v7/Core custody or an irreducible renderer defect may block the full-form run.
tracks.control: stable timing-law incumbent and serious literal co-play, never another bar-dragging family
machine_steps: Close v8 as non-discriminating and run single-speed, native-pocket, phrase-reset, or superior timing-law probes machine-side.
Reject timing laws with audible continuous drag, destructive drift, or repeated phase correction before owner review.
Rebuild the positive quiet-source-led introduction and crescendo under the surviving stable timing law.
Produce at least 45 seconds containing setup, stable body/groove, payoff, and semantically disclosed timing law.
tracks.owner_delta: stable band-following law and complete dramatic arc; no hidden mix-only variants sharing the same timing defect
tracks.working_title: The Four Seasons Beggin’ × Måneskin Beggin’
